notes.linked_aminoacids_format: Comma-separated residues with optional specificity scores in parentheses. E.g., 'K(0),S(0.2),T(0.2),Y(0.2),nterm(0)' where (0) = high specificity, (0.2) = lower. nterm/cterm = termini.
notes.asymmetric_format: Asymmetric crosslinkers use 'first_linked_aminoacids' and 'second_linked_aminoacids' instead of 'linked_aminoacids'
notes.stubs_format: Cleavage stubs as 'Residue,Mass' pairs comma-separated. E.g., 'A,54.0105647,S,103.9932001,T,85.9826354'. Only for MS-cleavable crosslinkers.
